description: NaLi₂MnCPO₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.91 Å. There are four inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.15 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.34 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.10 Å. In the fourth Li site, Li is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.14 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.32 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-66°. There are three shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond length. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Mn and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form corner-sharing OLi₂MnP tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramids that share corners with four OLi₂MnP tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiMnP tetrahedra that share corners with five ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramids. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form distorted ONaLi₂C tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiMnP tetrahedra.
